title: Exocrine Glands: Development, Function and Disease Conference
level: Scientists and graduate students (bachelor's degree in science/engineering required)
about: The 2027 Gordon Research Conference "Exocrine Glands: Development, Function and Disease" will take place from 31 January to 5 February 2027 in Ventura, United States. Applications must be submitted by 3 January 2027 through the conference page on grc.org.
requirements: Undergraduates or those without a bachelor's degree in science/engineering (or acceptable equivalent) are not eligible to apply (GRC policy)
card_alt: Card for "Exocrine Glands: Development, Function and Disease Conference" by Gordon Research Conferences in Ventura, United States, application deadline 3 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Statue of Liberty and the Manhattan skyline in New York, not Ventura.
